A simple music app using YouTube Music for backend 

Gratify is an open source project to stream music from YouTube and YouTube Music without ads and tracking. Gratify provides many features:

 - Streaming music 
 - Synced lyrics
 - Personalize data
 - etc… 

Gratify is always free and no ads
